hardwareCard.title: Hardware Tests
hardwareCard.desc: Test your mouse, monitor and click latency

games.reactionDesc: When the screen turns green, click as fast as you can. Measures your visual reaction latency.
games.gridshotDesc: Click as many targets as you can in 30 seconds. Targets spawn randomly in a grid.
games.trackingDesc: Hold left-click and follow the moving sphere for 30 seconds. Score = % time on target.
games.flickshotDesc: A single target pops at random. Click it as fast as possible, then return to center.
games.cpsDesc: Click as fast as you can for 10 seconds. Tests your physical click speed.
games.microshotsDesc: Same as gridshot but with tiny targets. Pure precision test.
games.strafeDesc: Click on moving targets that strafe horizontally. Trains kiting and prediction.
games.stroopDesc: Click the COLOR of the word, not its meaning. Cognitive aim test.
games.sequenceDesc: Memorize and repeat the growing sequence. Tests working memory.
games.visualMatchDesc: Click the target that matches the shown pattern. Decision-making under pressure.
games.pollingDesc: Move your mouse rapidly. Measures the real polling rate (Hz) of your mouse.
games.clickLatencyDesc: Click as fast as you can after the cue. Estimates your mouse hardware latency.
games.monitorHzDesc: Measures the real refresh rate of your monitor via requestAnimationFrame.
